title: Family Home Downtown Nashville
description:
Our family home is located in Hope Gardens, a beautiful urban neighborhood within walking distance to the Farmer's Market, The TN State Museum (free to the public!), Bicentennial Park, Germantown (& it's many amazing restaurants), North Gulch, Nashville Sounds ballpark & more! About 1 mile from downtown! Pet friendly with approval. Pet fee applies. Inquire for more information.

The space
Our home is the perfect spot to call home while you are visiting Nashville. 
It is a two story, four bedroom home with an open concept living, dining & kitchen area. Kitchen is fully stocked with everything you'll need to enjoy a meal at home but close enough to walk to some of Nashville's best restaurants & coffee shops. Living room has a large flat screen TV with Roku, Netflix & a BluRay DVD player. There is a bedroom with king size bed and a full bath on the first floor. 

There are three additional bedrooms and a second full bath on the second floor. Bedroom #2 has a queen bed. Bedroom #3 has two twin beds. Bedroom #4 has a king bed, a desk & TV. 

Pack 'n play & air mattress are available, upon request.

Outside, you'll enjoy a covered dining area that seats 10 along with a sunny rear deck and fully fenced in yard.

Pets are permitted with approval. Contact us for details about our pet fee before you book. If you bring a pet without prior approval, you will be charged a $200 pet fee per pet.

Check out instructions are in the guest folder & should be followed to avoid additional cleaning fees. Guests who do not follow check out instructions & leave a mess will be required to pay for additional cleaning services.

Guest access
- keyless entry makes for easy check in & easy access for you & your guests
- Fully equipped kitchen & laundry
- four bedrooms - one king down and 1 queen, 2 twins, 1 king up (air mattress, baby gates and pack & play available, upon request) 
- Two full baths
- Children's toys, books, games, movies, etc
- Flat screen tv with access to Netflix & more
- High Speed Wireless internet
- Covered outdoor dining area for 10+
- Charcoal/gas grill
- fully fenced yard

Other things to note
Help support Short Term Rentals in Nashville by renting only from legal, permitted properties.
Permit number shown in listing photos.
